purpose: silver_nyc_flights cleans the January-June 2013 NYC departure records (JFK, LGA, EWR) sourced from the nycflights13 flights table, dropping Airbyte capture metadata and typing the time, delay, and distance measures for downstream on-time-performance and delay analysis.
usage: Identify a scheduled flight by joining on year, month, day, carrier_code, flight, and origin_airport_code; because actual_departure_time, actual_arrival_time, departure_delay_minutes, arrival_delay_minutes, and air_time_minutes are null for flights that never departed or arrived, a consumer computing delay or duration aggregates must filter or explicitly handle those nulls rather than treat them as zero.
limitations: year, month, and day remain three separate INTEGER columns rather than a single DATE column because the cleanup's per-column action model cannot merge three bronze columns into one derived target; roughly 2.9%-3.3% of rows carry null departure/arrival times, delays, and air time for flights that did not depart or arrive, and tail_number is missing for 0.9% of rows, all retained as nulls rather than imputed or dropped.
